notes: Decision-logic fixtures for posting a review to a GitHub PR: verdict/severity -> review event mapping, inline anchoring rules, the self-review fallback, and out-of-diff handling. Five discriminating cases plus one over-trigger control (no review authored yet -> must route to the reviewer, not post). Grade with quoted evidence; a comparative benchmark snapshot is a follow-up skill-enhance iteration.

evals.name: blocker-requests-changes
evals.prompt:
Post this review to PR https://github.com/acme/app/pull/42:

## Verdict
Not merge-ready.

## BLOCKER
- B1 Duplicate charge on redelivery. ```10:14:src/consumer.ts```
expectations: Selects review event REQUEST_CHANGES because a BLOCKER is present
Parses the code ref 10:14:src/consumer.ts into an inline anchor on src/consumer.ts
Stages the payload and asks for explicit confirmation before posting

evals.name: only-medium-is-comment
evals.prompt:
Post this to acme/app#7:

## Verdict
Looks fine overall.

## MEDIUM
- M1 Add a test for the empty-list case.
## LOW
- L1 Rename `tmp` to something descriptive.
expectations: Selects review event COMMENT (no BLOCKER/HIGH present)
Does NOT select REQUEST_CHANGES or APPROVE
Renders no-code-ref findings into the summary body rather than dropping them

evals.name: merge-ready-approve
evals.prompt:
Post to acme/app#9:

## Verdict
MERGE-READY.

## QUESTION
- Q1 Any reason to keep the old flag? (non-blocking)
expectations: Selects review event APPROVE (verdict MERGE-READY, no BLOCKER/HIGH)
Keeps the QUESTION as a non-blocking comment, not a change request

evals.name: self-review-fallback
evals.prompt:
Post this review to my own PR acme/app#12 (I am the PR author):

## BLOCKER
- B1 SQL injection in the search endpoint. ```20:22:src/search.ts```
expectations: Recognizes GitHub forbids APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES on your own PR
Falls back to a COMMENT event (or a plain PR comment) instead of failing
Still surfaces the BLOCKER content; does not soften it

evals.name: out-of-diff-path-skipped
evals.prompt:
Post to acme/app#15. One finding anchors to `config/prod.yaml` which is NOT in this PR's changed files:

## HIGH
- H1 Secret committed. ```3:3:config/prod.yaml```
expectations: Detects that config/prod.yaml is not in the PR diff (via pulls/N/files)
Moves the finding to skipped_findings / folds it into the summary body instead of anchoring inline
Does not let one out-of-diff comment 422 the entire review

evals.name: control-no-review-authored
evals.prompt: Review PR https://github.com/acme/app/pull/20 for me and tell me if it's safe to merge.
expectations: Recognizes no written review was provided — this skill posts, it does not author
Declines per the applicability gate and routes to code-quality:code-reviewer
Does NOT fabricate a review or post anything to the PR
